title: Opt-in image export (SVG/PNG) for diagrams via mmdc
description: Owner approved 2026-10-06: diagram-review gains an opt-in export that renders Mermaid fences to SVG or PNG with @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (mmdc), locally, for slides, email or Confluence. Nothing is installed unless the user asks. mmdc needs ~640 MB for headless Chromium, and in the notation lab it exited 0 on a broken architecture-beta diagram while writing an SVG that said 'Syntax error', so the export must run after the parse check and verify its own output. No third-party render service is used.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The export installs mmdc only on explicit request, into a cache directory it owns, at a version whose bundled Mermaid matches the parse-check pin, and states the disk cost before installing
The export refuses any diagram that fails mermaid-check.mjs and renders nothing for it
An exported SVG or PNG that contains a Mermaid error render (e.g. "Syntax error") is treated as a failure, not a success
A self-test shows a broken diagram refused and a valid diagram exported to SVG and PNG
An uninstall option removes the cache directory and nothing else
diagram-review SKILL.md documents the opt-in export, its cost and its limits
